limitations: Source: Wens Foodstuff Group Co., Ltd., issuer announcement 2026-120, signed 8 October 2026, original CNINFO PDF. Necessary 22-cell factual excerpt; the three-page original was downloaded, extracted and visually inspected, not mirrored.

All numbers are directly published. Four paired business/month rows contain five numerical fields each; one September white-feather-chick row has two numerical fields. Monthly and YTD figures remain separate, and blank revenue/price fields are missing disclosures, not zeros.

Chicken sales volume and revenue cover live chickens, fresh products and prepared foods, while the quoted average is live-chicken price only. Pork sales cover live pigs and fresh products, while the average is live-pig price only. Do not multiply volume by price to reconstruct revenue, or treat either average as a standardized exchange spot quote.
The issuer distinguishes 2026 pork scope excluding piglets from 2025 scope including piglets. This excerpt uses August/September 2026 only and does not assert comparable prior-year pork volumes.

Numbers are unaudited internal operating disclosures, may have rounding differences, exclude other businesses and may differ from periodic reports. Sales do not alone establish own production, feed procurement, net exposure or profitability; no issuer relation is created from this table.
The existing read-source consumer preserves these operating facts and their scope; unknown tax treatment and market/contract conventions are not manufactured to fit an automatic price reader.
